caption:
Mutton keema near me in Hyderabad? Pepper keema fry, ready in 25 minutes 🐐🌶️ మిరియాల కీమా వేపుడు

Save this Saturday recipe 👇
🛒 You need: 500 g goat keema · 2 onions, finely chopped · 2 green chillies · a sprig of curry leaves · 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste · ½ tsp turmeric · 1 tsp red chilli powder · 1 tsp coriander powder · 1½ tsp freshly crushed black pepper · salt · 3 tbsp oil · coriander to finish
1️⃣ Heat oil in an iron kadai, fry curry leaves, chillies and onions till golden.
2️⃣ Add ginger-garlic paste and fry for a minute.
3️⃣ Add the keema, turmeric and salt; break it up and cook covered 12–15 minutes.
4️⃣ Add chilli and coriander powder, fry on high till dry.
5️⃣ Finish with crushed black pepper and coriander. Serve with rice, chapati or rotte.

Goat meat from our own goat farms, at your door in Hyderabad in 60–90 minutes. Never frozen, cut fresh every day.
📊 Per 100 g raw goat meat: protein 20.6 g, iron 2.8 mg, vitamin B12 1.1 µg (Source: USDA FoodData Central)
